items.question: What is Upanga: The Soul Blade?
items.answer: Upanga: The Soul Blade is a tactical, turn-based fantasy RPG where four heroes battle evil forces through the land of Bomende.

items.question: What platform is Upanga being developed for?
items.answer: Upanga is being developed for Android, Apple, and Steam.

items.question: What stage of development is the game in?
items.answer: Upanga is currently in Beta & currently going through internal tests.

items.question: Will the game be free?
items.answer: No decision has been made around the pricing of the game.

items.question: What kind of combat does Upanga use?
items.answer: Upanga uses initiative, tactical turn-based combat on an isometric grid. Players command heroes, move across tiles, spend action points, and fight enemies.

items.question: Can I save the game?
items.answer: The game is planned to support local, non-cloud saving using one save file. The goal is to allow players to save and load their current game state. Future state Google Cloud saves.

items.question: Is Upanga online or offline?
items.answer: Upanga is planned as a single-player game. Online features are not required at this stage.

items.question: When will Upanga be released?
items.answer: There is no final release date yet. The game is currently in development but targeting Fall of 2026.

items.question: Will there be a playtest?
items.answer: A playtest may be offered later when the game is ready.

items.question: How can I get updates?
items.answer: You can follow this website for updates and our social media accounts.

items.question: How can I contact the developer?
items.answer: You can contact the Upanga team at upangadev@zohomail.com.
